title: kith-store: max_changes=0 panics in get_querychanges_since_for_chat
description: When max_changes=Some(0) and there are pending changes, get_querychanges_since_for_chat fetches 1 row (limit=0+1=1), sets has_more=true (rows.len()>0), truncates rows to 0, then enters the has_more branch and calls rows.last().expect("rows is non-empty when has_more is true") on the now-empty vec. This panics unconditionally. Reachable from a JMAP caller sending "maxChanges": 0. Fix: capture last element before truncation, or derive new_state from the fetched-but-not-returned tail row.
